title: AeroSound 700 Wireless Headphones
description: Over-ear wireless headphones with industry-leading active noise cancelling, 30-hour battery life and plush memory-foam earcups. Ideal for long-haul flights, open offices and deep-focus work.

title: PulseFit Sport Earbuds
description: Sweat-proof in-ear buds with secure ear fins, 8-hour battery and punchy bass. Built for running, gym sessions and outdoor workouts in any weather.

title: EchoBeam Essential On-ear Headphones
description: Lightweight wired-or-wireless on-ear headphones at an entry-level price. Clear sound for podcasts, calls and casual listening.

title: StudioReference SR-900 Monitoring Headphones
description: Open-back studio reference headphones with a flat frequency response for mixing and mastering. Wired only, with a detachable coiled cable.

title: TinyTunes Kids Headphones
description: Volume-limited (85 dB) on-ear headphones for children, with a flexible unbreakable headband and fun sticker pack.

title: AeroSound 700 Travel Case
description: Hard-shell travel case custom-moulded for the AeroSound 700, with a cable pocket and carabiner loop.

title: ClearSig Portable USB-C DAC/Amp
description: Pocket-size DAC and headphone amplifier that drives high-impedance studio headphones from a phone or laptop over USB-C.
